card.name: Inside drug names, esp. warfarin
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a drug name split into parts, most often the "far" in warfarin. It also fires on the start or middle of other brand or generic names such as ribavirin, Evenity, Kybella, fingolimod and clozapine.
